classes: Classes 401 & 402 四年一班、四年二班
title: SDG 14 保育海洋生態
footer: Teacher Dom · SDG #14 Life Below Water 保育海洋生態

slides.eyebrow_en: The sea is closer than you think

slides.head_en: Thank you for the lion dance!

lines.en: I grew up in California, next to the Pacific Ocean.
lines.zh: 我在加州長大，就在太平洋旁邊。

lines.en: The sea was at the end of my street.
Today, let's talk about the sea near Erlin.
lines.zh: 今天，我們來聊聊二林附近的海。

slides.ask_en: Hands up — who has been to the beach?
Between my home and yours, it is all ocean — one big ocean.
slides.ask_zh: 我家和你家之間，全部都是海——同一片大海。

prompts.en: Stand up if you have seen the sea.
Stand up if you have eaten oysters.
Stand up if you have seen a dolphin.

slides.punch_en: Those oysters grew in the sea near Erlin!
slides.punch_zh: 那些蚵仔，就長在二林附近的海裡！

slides.head_en: from your school to the sea
slides.body_en: Wanggong Harbor is about 20 minutes away by car.
slides.body_zh: 開車到王功漁港，大約 20 分鐘。

slides.head_zh: 台灣白海豚，剩下不到 50 隻
slides.body_en: People call them Matsu fish. They live only near Taiwan's west coast — near Changhua!
slides.body_zh: 大家叫牠們「媽祖魚」，只住在台灣西海岸——就在彰化附近！
slides.ask_en: Your school has more students than the world has white dolphins.
slides.ask_zh: 你們學校的學生，比全世界的白海豚還多。

slides.q_en: How much of the Earth is ocean?
slides.q_zh: 地球表面有多少是海洋？
slides.explain_en: About 70%! Our planet is mostly blue.
slides.explain_zh: 大約 70%！我們的星球大部分是藍色的。

slides.q_en: Where does most ocean plastic come from?
slides.q_zh: 海裡的塑膠，大部分是從哪裡來的？
slides.explain_en: From the land! Trash goes into drains and rivers, and rivers carry it to the sea.
slides.explain_zh: 從陸地！垃圾掉進水溝和河裡，河再把它帶到海裡。

slides.head_zh: 真的還假的？手比 ⭕ 或 ❌

items.en: A plastic bottle disappears in the sea in one year.
items.zh: 塑膠瓶在海裡一年就會消失。
items.note_en: No! It can take about 450 years.

items.en: A sea turtle can think a plastic bag is a jellyfish.
items.zh: 海龜會把塑膠袋當成水母。
items.note_en: Yes — and it tries to eat it.
items.note_zh: 對——而且牠會想把它吃下去。

items.en: About half of the air we breathe comes from the ocean.
items.zh: 我們呼吸的空氣，大約一半來自海洋。
items.note_en: Yes! Tiny plants in the sea make it.
items.note_zh: 對！是海裡的小小植物做出來的。

slides.body_en: In Fangyuan, next to Erlin, farmers walk oxen onto the mudflat to pick oysters. Only about a dozen of these oxen are left in the world.
slides.body_zh: 在二林隔壁的芳苑，蚵農牽著牛走進潮間帶採蚵仔。這樣的「海牛」，全世界只剩大約十幾頭。

slides.rule_en: In 30 seconds, say as many sea animals in English as you can. I will count!
slides.rule_zh: 30 秒內，用英文說出越多海洋動物越好，我來數！

slides.note_en: Watch, then tell me: which sea animal do you want to protect?
slides.note_zh: 看完之後，告訴我：你想保護哪一種海洋動物？

slides.prompt_en: Which sea animal do you want to protect?
slides.prompt_zh: 你想保護哪一種海洋動物？
slides.time_en: 30 seconds each. Then I will ask three of you.
slides.time_zh: 每人 30 秒。然後我會請三位分享。

slides.note_zh: 唸三遍——一次比一次大聲！

items.en: Put trash in the trash can, not the drain.
items.zh: 垃圾丟進垃圾桶，不丟水溝。

items.en: Tell my family: “Keep the ocean clean!”
items.zh: 告訴家人：「讓大海保持乾淨！」

slides.big_en:
The sea is our neighbor.
Let's keep it blue!
slides.big_zh:
大海是我們的鄰居，
一起讓它保持藍色！
